text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: What happens after you close a LinkedIn account
From LinkedIn Help and the LinkedIn Privacy Policy, read 4 November 2026

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: RIGHT AWAY
The account is closed immediately.
Help: Profile displays incorrectly in search tool results

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: WITHIN 24 HOURS
Your data generally stops being visible to others on LinkedIn.
Privacy Policy, section 4.3

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: UP TO 72 HOURS
Your public profile is removed from LinkedIn.
Help: Profile displays incorrectly in search tool results

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: UNDER 14 DAYS
In most cases you can reopen: log in, click Reactivate, confirm.
Not restored: endorsements, recommendations, groups, followings, invitations

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: WITHIN 30 DAYS
LinkedIn generally deletes closed account information.
Except what it keeps for legal, security and fraud reasons (Privacy Policy 4.3)

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: UNTIL THEY REFRESH
Search engines may still show your profile from their cache.
Help: Close and delete your account; Privacy Policy 4.3
